# Lamp Builder 1.2.3
- Replaced the always-open balance panel with a compact stability meter fixed in the upper-left corner of the canvas. - The meter fills upward as the estimated base margin decreases, with green, amber and red states. Unsupported assemblies show “Add a base” instead of a low-risk reading. - Click the meter to expand the footprint, estimated loads, tipping animation and suggestions. Close with the X, Escape or a click outside; details stay closed until requested again. - Quick Connect and cord-placement controls remain available beneath the compact meter.
The meter is a relative planning indicator, not a probability of tipping or a structural safety certification.
